text:
jas: quick q — if the shard provenance (safetensors checksum/manifest) changes mid-rollout, how do we avoid double warmup or stale KV cache hits? seeing a few 503s in canary.
anya: did you repro? which loader path (index-first vs manifestless)?
jas: repro on dev with index-first loader + manifest overlay. steps: push new safetensors with different layout but same shard ids. canary got partly warm, then fallback to compatible smaller-quant model -> errors.
mike: hmm, two problems: (1) ambiguity in shard identity (filename vs content-hash). (2) warmup dedupe key is currently shard_id only. we should include provenance hash.
sara: +1 include content-hash. but watch perf: hashing 100GB archive on cold path is rough.
kevin: suggestion: use quick manifest-level digest (metadata blob hash) and fall back to full content-hash async. Warmup key = (shard_id, manifest_digest). If manifest_digest mismatches later, trigger background reconcile.
jas: that could work. also need to handle safetensors aliasing where shapes same but order changed. manifest_digest should include byte-level ordering.
anya: practical snippet — propose manifest digest in metadata.json:
```
{
  "manifest_version": "1",
  "shards":[{"id":"s-000","path":"...","digest":"sha256:abcd..."}],
  "manifest_digest": "sha256:fff..."
}
```
mike: warmup routing: should we route to old live pool until new manifest fully warm? I think yes: staged warmup with grace_period flag.
sara: grace_period = X requests or Y seconds? prefer time-based + hit-count. e.g., grace=60s or 1k requests, whichever first.
kevin: need to ensure cache eviction logic not to evict old shard until new is stable.
jas: ops-bot: deploy marker?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout id=rl-2026-03-20 started at 2026-03-20T14:12Z
anya: also add fallback mapping: if new shard missing quant variant, fallback to quantized variant from previous manifest.
mike: long-term refactor: unify weightsource interface to expose (shard_id, manifest_digest, provenance) and lifecycle hooks: on_warmstart, on_reconcile, on_eviction.
sara: that's the API we discussed in RFC v2 but never implemented; +1.
jas: ok next actions: 1) change warmup key to include manifest_digest 2) implement time+hit grace routing 3) add background full-content hash job 4) update loader docs and manifest schema.
kevin: assign owners: mike#eng-ml, anya#eng-runtime, jas#eng-ml for tests, infra to update rollout bot.
mike: will open PR with small change to warmup key — will include perf microbench for hashing.
jas: thanks. will monitor canary. :thumbsup:
sara: fyi: small edgecase — if manifest_digest collides (unlikely) we have fallback to content-hash; log with high severity so we can alert.
infra-bot: incident-bot: created alert "shard-provenance-mismatch" for canary group.
